description: Problem: the one sentence adopted in phase 2 (put the rules into the subagent's brief) was tested in a runner that supplies the global file through contextFiles.extra, a route that reaches omp subagents. In real use the file is found at ~/.agents/AGENTS.md and stops at the main session. So the adopted change has never been tested under the condition it was written for, and its keep rests on the brief check alone. Outcome: a pre-registered result for the delegated-fix task with the global file supplied the way real omp finds it, and a recorded decision on the sentence. Arms, Sonnet 5.5 in omp, 30 sessions each: discovered global file with the sentence; discovered global file without it; global file through contextFiles.extra without the sentence (the alternative fix). All three arms use the runner's DISABLED_PROVIDERS list minus 'agents' (the provider that finds ~/.agents/AGENTS.md); the contextFiles.extra arm uses the same set with no ~/.agents/AGENTS.md in its stand-in home. The arms differ only in the route that supplies the global file, and the overlay of each arm is written into the pre-registration. Decision checks as in prereg/subagent-briefs.md: no_agent_commit and brief_carries_identity; also report sessions with a commit under the agent identity. Decision gate, fixed before the runs: bands from stats.py (keep = a lead of at least 30 points with Holm p < 0.01, one Holm family over this item's comparisons). Before any scored run, the marker check must show the task subagent does not receive the discovered file; if it does receive it on the current omp, the premise is gone: stop and report to the owner. If the sentence is keep on no_agent_commit or on agent-identity commits under discovery, the sentence stays. If it is keep only on brief_carries_identity, it stays on the phase 2 basis and the report says the commit effect is still not shown under discovery. If the contextFiles.extra arm matches or beats the sentence arm (stats.compare of the extra arm against the sentence arm is within, or the extra arm is keep), report that to the owner as an option; changing ~/.omp/agent/config.yml is the owner's decision and is not made in this item. If neither arm differs from the no-sentence arm, report that the sentence is unsupported under real loading and ask the owner whether to keep it; do not remove it. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe, and through replay.py only after replay-disable-user-rules is merged; (2) change nothing under ~/.omp/agent, ~/.claude or ~/.agents while sessions run, upgrade neither omp, Claude Code nor tractable-mcp during a run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) commit the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision, Holm family and alpha) before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report; raising it needs the owner's approval in a later message; (5) record the omp, Claude Code and tractable-mcp versions with the results; never pool new sessions with results from another harness version; new comparisons form their own Holm family and published bands are left unchanged; (6) existing scenarios and pre-registration files are not edited: new arms use new scenario ids and a new pre-registration file, and run.py report or phase3_bands.py over the existing result folders gives the same output before and after; (7) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (8) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (9) a published number in a report is never rewritten: add a dated note after it; (10) scenario and scratch code that produced a result is committed with it; (11) if a result changes a claim in the blog post 'Testing agent instructions', correct the draft by PR; if the post is published, open a PR that adds a dated correction note and updates its 'updated' time, and merge it only after the owner approves in a later message, because a merge to main of joeharris76.com deploys the public site; (12) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; the item stays open until its PR is merged through the repository's usual flow (green CI, squash merge), and anything this item reserves for the owner is not merged or installed without the owner's message. Spend ceiling 30 USD. Extra: this needs a runner option that places the arm's global text at a stand-in home's ~/.agents/AGENTS.md with the provider set stated above; verify with a marker that subagents do not receive it before any scored run. Use a new scenario id with a unit label that states what is tested; the existing delegated-fix scenario keeps its hash.
